headline: A federal law renames a San Diego post office after former Congresswoman Susan A. Davis.
what_it_does: This act names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 6401 El Cajon Boulevard in San Diego, California, the Susan A. Davis Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or the staff who work there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the renaming took effect on that date.
